dictionary.title: Client Link
dictionary.description_local: Secure pairing for the devices that talk to {assistant}
dictionary.description_node: Status of the encrypted link between this node and the server
dictionary.notice_unpaired: This node is visible on the mesh but not paired: generate a code on the server to pair it.
dictionary.notice_removed: This node is no longer paired: its token is no longer valid.
dictionary.pairing_hint: Enter the code in the device app. It lasts 10 minutes and works once.
dictionary.found_hint: These devices announce themselves but are not paired yet.
dictionary.metrics_empty: The node has not sent any measurements yet.
dictionary.unpair_hint: Revoking the pairing invalidates the node's token immediately: a new code will be needed to reconnect it.
dictionary.unpair_body: {name} will no longer be able to talk to the server until it is paired again.
